decision.message:
Elowen, I'm handing this to you because it needs a decision on spend and on the deposit, and I don't have the authority to make either.

Where things stand at 7 Brackenmere Walk (vacant, agency keys):
1. Approval: Larkspan quoted £180 + VAT (£36 VAT, £216 total, ref NBL-024-Q1) for an end-of-occupancy clean (E011, A2). The workflow put this above its £100 threshold and sent it for landlord approval (E017). We asked Sella Voss to approve or reject it on 18 Sep (E018) and reminded her on 21 Sep (E019). She hasn't replied. The 'approval already obtained' flag in E002 and E005 has no approval message or document behind it.
2. Reported completion: your note of 23 Sep says the clear-out and property service 'was done today' (E020). Nothing from Larkspan confirms that they went: no completion message, no photos (promised in E011) and no invoice. The E010 call mentions a message confirming engagement, but that message isn't on file.
3. Deposit: E015 says work was on hold until the deposit claim was decided. No decision is recorded.
4. Scope: the checkout report asks for items to be removed from the kitchen drawers, garden storage box, kitchen bins and cellar (vacuum, brush, dustpan, mop, toilet brush) before the final service (A1). The quote covers cleaning only and doesn't mention removal (A2). The approval request didn't point out this gap (E018).

Decisions only you can make:
(a) Who authorised Larkspan to go ahead, and on what basis, given that the landlord hasn't approved the quote.
(b) How to put this to Sella. Either ask for retrospective approval of the £180 + VAT, setting out the removal gap and any extra cost, or deal with it as an agency matter. Please don't tell her the work is finished until we have evidence.
(c) The deposit and recharge decision: whether the outgoing tenant bears the cost.
(d) Where the keys are now.

In this same turn I've emailed Larkspan for written confirmation of what was done and when, completion photos, whether removal was included, and their invoice as a PDF. I've told them this doesn't approve any amount. Nothing has gone to the landlord. I'll check for Larkspan's reply on 25 Sep.
decision.rationale: The normal next step here would be to tell the landlord the work is done (landlord.update) or to chase her approval. Neither is safe. The work is reported done (E020), but the £180 + VAT quote was never approved (E017–E019, E021). That is unapproved spend. On top of that, a deposit or recharge decision is open (E015), the facts conflict (the approval flag in E002 has nothing behind it, and there is no completion evidence), and the quote leaves out removal, which the checkout report asks for (A1 vs A2). The manual lists unapproved spend, deposit or recharge decisions and conflicting facts as reasons to escalate. Following refinement 6, the routine evidence request goes to the contractor in the same turn, so the handover only covers the decisions a person has to make.

1. Work reported done without approval. Your note of 23 Sep (E020) says the clear-out and property service "was done today". But the quote is still unapproved. Larkspan quoted £180 + VAT (£216 incl. VAT, ref NBL-024-Q1) on 9 Sep (E011, A2). You asked Sella to approve it on 18 Sep (E018) and reminded her on 21 Sep (E019). She has not replied to either. The E002 flag says approval was "already obtained", but no approval message or document backs it up.
2. Deposit decision. Your note of 10 Sep (E015) says the deposit claim decision was needed before work went ahead. No decision is recorded, so it is still open whether the cost goes to the outgoing tenant or the landlord.
3. Scope gap. The request and checkout report (S:initial-request, A1) list removing items from the kitchen drawers, garden storage box, kitchen bins and cellar (vacuum, sweeping brush, dustpan, mop and toilet brush). (b) The deposit/recharge decision: who bears this cost?

The landlord has not answered the approval request (E018) or the reminder (E019), and the workflow is still at quote approval (E021). final.rationale: The normal next step here would be to tell the landlord the work is done (landlord.update) or to chase her approval. Neither is safe. On top of that, a deposit or recharge decision is open (E015), the facts conflict (the approval flag in E002 has nothing behind it, and there is no completion evidence), and the quote leaves out removal, which the checkout report asks for (A1 vs A2).
